with bounds as (
 select f.release_id,min(d.calendar_date) as first_day,max(d.calendar_date) as last_day
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
 join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."calendar_date" d on d.date_key=f.date_key group by f.release_id
)
select b.release_id,d.* from bounds b
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."calendar_date" d on d.calendar_date between b.first_day and b.last_day
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=b.release_id)

-- A multi-city job can occur in several groups; do not add rows into a global total.
select f.release_id,f.date_key,c.city_key,c.city_name,c.province_name,c.mapping_status,
 count_big(*) as posting_count
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_daily_city" b on b.release_id=f.release_id and b.date_key=f.date_key and b.job_key=f.job_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."city" c on c.city_key=b.city_key
where f.is_core=1 and exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=f.release_id)
group by f.release_id,f.date_key,c.city_key,c.city_name,c.province_name,c.mapping_status

select b.release_id,b.date_key,b.job_key,
 concat(b.release_id,'|',b.date_key,'|',b.job_key) as snapshot_key,
 c.city_name,c.province_name,c.mapping_status
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_daily_city" b
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."city" c on c.city_key=b.city_key
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=b.release_id)

-- One release x batch-end Beijing day. Missing expected sources remain incomplete.
with expected as (
 select b.release_id,count_big(*) as expected_source_count
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."model_build" b cross apply openjson(b.expected_sources_json) s
 group by b.release_id
), coverage as (
 select release_id,date_key,count_big(*) as observed_source_count,
  sum(case when coverage_status='complete' and acceptance_status='accepted' then 1 else 0 end) as complete_source_count
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."release_input" group by release_id,date_key
), metrics as (
 select release_id,date_key,count_big(*) as source_posting_count,
  sum(cast(is_core as bigint)) as core_posting_count,
  sum(case when is_core=1 and body_valid=1 then cast(1 as bigint) else 0 end) as skill_denominator
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" group by release_id,date_key
)
select m.*,e.expected_source_count,c.observed_source_count,c.complete_source_count,
 cast(case when c.complete_source_count=e.expected_source_count then 1 else 0 end as bit) as is_complete
from metrics m join expected e on e.release_id=m.release_id
join coverage c on c.release_id=m.release_id and c.date_key=m.date_key

-- B03: one mutually exclusive category x education x experience x employment group.
select release_id,date_key,source_key,category_key,education_key,experience_key,employment_type_key,
 count_big(*) as core_posting_count,
 sum(case when body_valid=1 then cast(1 as bigint) else 0 end) as skill_denominator
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily"
where is_core=1
group by release_id,date_key,source_key,category_key,education_key,experience_key,employment_type_key

-- B01: one release x day x source x standard job category, before multi-value expansion.
select f.release_id,f.date_key,f.source_key,f.category_key,
 count_big(*) as core_posting_count,
 sum(case when f.body_valid=1 then cast(1 as bigint) else 0 end) as skill_denominator,
 sum(case when exists_skill.job_key is not null then cast(1 as bigint) else 0 end) as skilled_posting_count
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
left join (
 select distinct release_id,date_key,job_key from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_daily_skill"
) exists_skill on exists_skill.release_id=f.release_id and exists_skill.date_key=f.date_key and exists_skill.job_key=f.job_key
where f.is_core=1
group by f.release_id,f.date_key,f.source_key,f.category_key

select b.release_id,b.date_key,b.job_key,
 concat(b.release_id,'|',b.date_key,'|',b.job_key) as snapshot_key,s.skill_name
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_daily_skill" b
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."skill" s on s.skill_key=b.skill_key
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=b.release_id)

select b.batch_id,b.source,b.scope_version,b.coverage_status,b.acceptance_status,
       b.source_revision,cast(case when b.acceptance_status='accepted' then N'采集技术验收通过，联调中' else N'采集待验收，联调中' end as nvarchar(50)) as dataset_status,
       count_big(o.observation_key) as source_posting_count,
       sum(cast(o.body_valid as bigint)) as body_valid_count,
       sum(case when o.education_raw is null then cast(1 as bigint) else 0 end) as education_missing_count,
       sum(case when o.category_raw is null then cast(1 as bigint) else 0 end) as category_missing_count
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."collection_batch" b
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_posting_observation" o on o.batch_id=b.batch_id
where b.load_mode='trial'
group by b.batch_id,b.source,b.scope_version,b.coverage_status,b.acceptance_status,b.source_revision

select o.batch_id,coalesce(l.location_raw,N'未知') as location_raw,
       count_big(distinct o.posting_key) as source_posting_count
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_posting_observation" o
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_version_location" b on b.version_key=o.version_key and b.normalization_version='raw_location_v1'
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."location" l on l.location_key=b.location_key
group by o.batch_id,coalesce(l.location_raw,N'未知')

select o.observation_key from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_posting_observation" o
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_version" v on v.version_key=o.version_key and v.posting_key=o.posting_key
where v.version_key is null or o.observed_at<v.valid_from_observed
   or (v.valid_to_observed is not null and o.observed_at>=v.valid_to_observed)

-- Read-only set fixtures, never inserted into real recruitment evidence.
-- A disappears for >=2 days; B returns and must not count as first discovery.
with fact as (
 select * from (values (1,1,'A',1),(1,1,'B',1),(1,2,'B',1),(1,2,'C',1),
  (1,3,'C',1),(1,3,'D',1),(1,4,'B',1),(1,4,'D',1),(1,4,'X',0))
 v(release_id,date_key,job_key,is_core)
), cases as (
 select * from (values (2,1,1,1,1,0),(3,2,1,1,1,1),(4,3,1,1,0,1),
  (4,3,0,cast(null as int),cast(null as int),cast(null as int)))
 v(date_key,previous_key,is_comparable,expected_new,expected_first,expected_missing)
), actual as (
 select d.*,
  case when d.is_comparable=1 then (select count_big(*)
 from fact current_job
 where current_job.release_id=1 and current_job.is_core=1
 
 and current_job.date_key=d.date_key
 and not exists (select 1 from fact seen
   where seen.release_id=current_job.release_id and seen.job_key=current_job.job_key and seen.is_core=1
   and seen.date_key =d.previous_key)
 ) end as new_count,
  case when d.is_comparable=1 then (select count_big(*)
 from fact current_job
 where current_job.release_id=1 and current_job.is_core=1
 
 and current_job.date_key=d.date_key
 and not exists (select 1 from fact seen
   where seen.release_id=current_job.release_id and seen.job_key=current_job.job_key and seen.is_core=1
   and seen.date_key <d.date_key)
 ) end as first_count,
  case when d.is_comparable=1 then (select count_big(distinct current_job.job_key)
 from fact current_job
 where current_job.release_id=1 and current_job.is_core=1
 
 and current_job.date_key<d.previous_key
 and not exists (select 1 from fact seen
   where seen.release_id=current_job.release_id and seen.job_key=current_job.job_key and seen.is_core=1
     and seen.date_key in (d.date_key,d.previous_key))
 ) end as missing_count
 from cases d
)
select * from actual where coalesce(new_count,-1)<>coalesce(expected_new,-1)
 or coalesce(first_count,-1)<>coalesce(expected_first,-1) or coalesce(missing_count,-1)<>coalesce(expected_missing,-1)

select f.release_id,f.date_key,f.job_key
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."model_build" b on b.release_id=f.release_id
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."job_qualification_evidence" q on q.release_id=f.release_id and q.date_key=f.date_key and q.job_key=f.job_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."education" ed on ed.education_key=f.education_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."experience" ex on ex.experience_key=f.experience_key
where b.normalization_version in ('conformed-cn-1.1','conformed-cn-1.2') and (
 q.job_key is null or json_value(q.education_resolution_json,'$.value')<>ed.education_name
 or json_value(q.experience_resolution_json,'$.value')<>ex.experience_name
 or (json_value(q.education_resolution_json,'$.status') in ('not_stated','preference_only') and ed.education_name<>N'未注明'))

select s.build_id
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."analysis_selection" s
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."analysis_build" b on b.build_id=s.build_id and b.batch_id=s.batch_id
where b.build_id is null or b.status<>'ready'

-- Contract fixtures only: no synthetic records are written into business tables.
-- A third-field-only body belongs in the denominator only for a three-field build.
with cases as (
 select * from (values
  (0,cast(N'熟悉 SQL' as nvarchar(100)),cast('description_raw+requirements_raw+additional_requirements_raw' as varchar(100)),1),
  (0,N'熟悉 SQL','description_raw+requirements_raw',0),
  (0,cast(null as nvarchar(100)),'description_raw+requirements_raw+additional_requirements_raw',0),
  (0,N' '+nchar(9)+nchar(10),'description_raw+requirements_raw+additional_requirements_raw',0),
  (1,cast(null as nvarchar(100)),'description_raw+requirements_raw',1)
 ) v(base_valid,additional_body,text_scope,expected)
)
select * from cases
where cast(case
 when base_valid=1 then 1
 when charindex('additional_requirements_raw', text_scope)>0
  and nullif(ltrim(rtrim(replace(replace(replace(additional_body,char(9),' '),char(10),' '),char(13),' '))),N'') is not null then 1
 else 0 end as bit)<>expected

select a.version_key from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_version" a
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_version" b
on a.posting_key=b.posting_key and a.version_key<b.version_key
and a.valid_from_observed<coalesce(b.valid_to_observed,convert(datetimeoffset,'9999-12-31'))
and b.valid_from_observed<coalesce(a.valid_to_observed,convert(datetimeoffset,'9999-12-31'))

select f.release_id,f.date_key,s.skill_key,s.skill_name,count_big(*) as posting_count,m.skill_denominator,
 cast(count_big(*) as float)/nullif(m.skill_denominator,0) as skill_share
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_daily_skill" b on b.release_id=f.release_id and b.date_key=f.date_key and b.job_key=f.job_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."skill" s on s.skill_key=b.skill_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_daily_summary" m on m.release_id=f.release_id and m.date_key=f.date_key
where f.is_core=1 and f.body_valid=1 and exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=f.release_id)
group by f.release_id,f.date_key,s.skill_key,s.skill_name,m.skill_denominator

select m.release_id,m.date_key,d.calendar_date as analysis_date,s.source_code as source,
 c.category_name as category_group,e.education_name as education_group,
 x.experience_name as experience_group,t.employment_type_name as employment_type_group,
 m.core_posting_count,m.skill_denominator
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_entry_profile" m
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."calendar_date" d on d.date_key=m.date_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."source" s on s.source_key=m.source_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."job_category" c on c.category_key=m.category_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."education" e on e.education_key=m.education_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."experience" x on x.experience_key=m.experience_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."employment_type" t on t.employment_type_key=m.employment_type_key
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=m.release_id)

select m.release_id,m.date_key,d.calendar_date as analysis_date,s.source_code as source,
 c.category_name as category_group,m.core_posting_count,m.skill_denominator,m.skilled_posting_count,
 cast(m.skill_denominator as float)/nullif(m.core_posting_count,0) as body_coverage,
 cast(m.skilled_posting_count as float)/nullif(m.skill_denominator,0) as skill_coverage
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_job_structure" m
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."calendar_date" d on d.date_key=m.date_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."source" s on s.source_key=m.source_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."job_category" c on c.category_key=m.category_key
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=m.release_id)

-- B02: a skill's numerator and the WHOLE category's eligible body denominator.
select f.release_id,f.date_key,f.source_key,f.category_key,b.skill_key,
 count_big(*) as posting_count,m.skill_denominator
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_daily_skill" b
 on b.release_id=f.release_id and b.date_key=f.date_key and b.job_key=f.job_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_job_structure" m
 on m.release_id=f.release_id and m.date_key=f.date_key and m.source_key=f.source_key and m.category_key=f.category_key
where f.is_core=1 and f.body_valid=1
group by f.release_id,f.date_key,f.source_key,f.category_key,b.skill_key,m.skill_denominator
select * from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."trial_batch_summary"

select c.*,b.dataset_status,b.coverage_status,b.acceptance_status,b.source_revision
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."trial_city_distribution" c
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."trial_batch_summary" b on b.batch_id=c.batch_id

select b.build_id,b.scope_version,b.dictionary_version,b.rule_version,b.body_hash_version,b.status as build_status,
 o.batch_id,i.source,i.source_job_id,o.observation_key,o.version_key,o.title_raw,o.analysis_date,
 o.category_raw,o.education_raw,o.experience_raw,o.source_url,
 cast(case
 when o.body_valid=1 then 1
 when charindex('additional_requirements_raw', b.skill_text_scope)>0
  and nullif(ltrim(rtrim(replace(replace(replace(e.additional_requirements_raw,char(9),' '),char(10),' '),char(13),' '))),N'') is not null then 1
 else 0 end as bit) as body_valid,
 e.is_core,e.scope_reason,e.additional_requirements_raw,e.location_notes_raw,
 e.location_conflict,e.experience_conflict,e.education_conflict,e.experience_hint,e.confirmed_locations_json,e.issues_json,
 e.raw_ref,e.raw_sha256,v.payload as content_json,
 c.acceptance_status,c.coverage_status,c.source_revision,
 b.skill_text_scope
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."analysis_build" b
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."observation_enrichment" e on e.build_id=b.build_id
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_posting_observation" o on o.observation_key=e.observation_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_identity" i on i.posting_key=o.posting_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_version" v on v.version_key=o.version_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."collection_batch" c on c.batch_id=o.batch_id
where b.status='ready'

-- Comparable consecutive complete days only. Same normalization/extraction versions fixed per release.
with days as (
 select m.*,d.calendar_date,
  p.date_key as previous_date_key,p.is_complete as previous_complete
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_daily_summary" m
 join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."calendar_date" d on d.date_key=m.date_key
 left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."calendar_date" pd on pd.calendar_date=dateadd(day,-1,d.calendar_date)
 left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_daily_summary" p on p.release_id=m.release_id and p.date_key=pd.date_key
)
select d.release_id,d.date_key,d.calendar_date,d.previous_date_key,
 d.source_posting_count,d.core_posting_count,d.skill_denominator,d.expected_source_count,
 d.observed_source_count,d.complete_source_count,d.is_complete,
 cast(case when d.is_complete=1 and d.previous_complete=1 then 1 else 0 end as bit) as is_comparable,
 case when d.is_complete=1 and d.previous_complete=1 then
  (select count_big(*)
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" current_job
 where current_job.release_id=d.release_id and current_job.is_core=1
 
 and current_job.date_key=d.date_key
 and not exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" seen
   where seen.release_id=current_job.release_id and seen.job_key=current_job.job_key and seen.is_core=1
   and seen.date_key =d.previous_date_key)
 ) end as newly_observed_count,
 case when d.is_complete=1 and d.previous_complete=1 then
  (select count_big(*)
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" current_job
 where current_job.release_id=d.release_id and current_job.is_core=1
 
 and current_job.date_key=d.date_key
 and not exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" seen
   where seen.release_id=current_job.release_id and seen.job_key=current_job.job_key and seen.is_core=1
   and seen.date_key <d.date_key)
 ) end as first_discovered_count,
 case when d.is_complete=1 and d.previous_complete=1 then
  (select count_big(distinct current_job.job_key)
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" current_job
 where current_job.release_id=d.release_id and current_job.is_core=1
 
 and current_job.date_key<d.previous_date_key
 and not exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" seen
   where seen.release_id=current_job.release_id and seen.job_key=current_job.job_key and seen.is_core=1
     and seen.date_key in (d.date_key,d.previous_date_key))
 ) end as still_unobserved_count,
 case when d.is_complete=1 and d.previous_complete=1 then (
  select count_big(*) from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
  join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" p on p.release_id=f.release_id and p.job_key=f.job_key and p.date_key=d.previous_date_key
  join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_version" fv on fv.version_key=f.representative_version_key
  join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_version" pv on pv.version_key=p.representative_version_key
  where f.release_id=d.release_id and f.date_key=d.date_key and f.is_core=1 and p.is_core=1 and fv.content_hash<>pv.content_hash
 ) end as content_changed_count,
 case when d.is_complete=1 and d.previous_complete=1 then N'相邻完整观察日；新增观察不等于企业新发布'
      when d.is_complete=0 then N'当前日缺来源或扫描不完整'
      else N'无相邻完整基线；不计算变化' end as comparison_note
from days d
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=d.release_id)

select o.observation_key,o.batch_id,i.source,i.source_job_id,o.version_key,o.analysis_date,
 o.title_raw,o.company_raw,o.category_raw,o.education_raw,o.experience_raw,o.employment_type_raw,
 o.source_url, v.payload as content_json,b.source_revision,b.coverage_status,b.acceptance_status,
 cast(case when b.acceptance_status='accepted' then N'采集技术验收通过，联调中' else N'采集待验收，联调中' end as nvarchar(50)) as dataset_status
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_posting_observation" o
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_identity" i on i.posting_key=o.posting_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."posting_version" v on v.version_key=o.version_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."collection_batch" b on b.batch_id=o.batch_id

select m.release_id,m.date_key,d.calendar_date as analysis_date,s.source_code as source,
 c.category_name as category_group,k.skill_name,m.posting_count,m.skill_denominator,
 cast(m.posting_count as float)/nullif(m.skill_denominator,0) as skill_share
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_skill_profile" m
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."calendar_date" d on d.date_key=m.date_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."source" s on s.source_key=m.source_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."job_category" c on c.category_key=m.category_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."skill" k on k.skill_key=m.skill_key
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=m.release_id)

-- Topic aggregates must conserve core/body populations before city/skill expansion.
with by_topic as (
 select release_id,date_key,sum(core_posting_count) as core_count,sum(skill_denominator) as body_count
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_job_structure" group by release_id,date_key
), by_entry as (
 select release_id,date_key,sum(core_posting_count) as core_count,sum(skill_denominator) as body_count
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_entry_profile" group by release_id,date_key
)
select t.release_id,t.date_key,'structure_population_mismatch' as issue
from by_topic t join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_daily_summary" d on d.release_id=t.release_id and d.date_key=t.date_key
where t.core_count<>d.core_posting_count or t.body_count<>d.skill_denominator
union all
select e.release_id,e.date_key,'entry_population_mismatch'
from by_entry e join by_topic t on t.release_id=e.release_id and t.date_key=e.date_key
where e.core_count<>t.core_count or e.body_count<>t.body_count
union all
select p.release_id,p.date_key,'skill_denominator_mismatch'
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_skill_profile" p join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_job_structure" t
 on t.release_id=p.release_id and t.date_key=p.date_key and t.source_key=p.source_key and t.category_key=p.category_key
where p.skill_denominator<>t.skill_denominator or p.posting_count>p.skill_denominator

select b.batch_id from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."collection_batch" b
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."trial_overview" s on s.batch_id=b.batch_id
where s.source_posting_count is null or s.source_posting_count<>b.record_count
   or s.body_valid_count>s.source_posting_count

select c.batch_id from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."trial_city" c
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."trial_overview" b on b.batch_id=c.batch_id
where c.source_posting_count>b.source_posting_count

select b.build_id from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_version_skill" b
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_job_detail" j on j.build_id=b.build_id and j.version_key=b.version_key
where j.version_key is null
or (b.eligible_for_metric=1 and b.requirement_level=N'不确定')

select build_id from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_job_detail"
where (body_hash_version='skills-body-1.1' and skill_text_scope<>'description_raw+requirements_raw+additional_requirements_raw')
   or (body_hash_version='skills-body-1.0' and skill_text_scope<>'description_raw+requirements_raw')

select release_id,date_key from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."release_observed_change"
where (is_comparable=0 and (newly_observed_count is not null or content_changed_count is not null
 or first_discovered_count is not null or still_unobserved_count is not null))
 or (is_comparable=1 and (newly_observed_count is null or first_discovered_count is null
 or still_unobserved_count is null or first_discovered_count>newly_observed_count
 or newly_observed_count+content_changed_count>core_posting_count))

select j.*,
 cast(case when exists (
   select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."quality_issue" q
   where q.batch_id=j.batch_id
     and json_value(q.payload,'$.source_job_id') COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2=j.source_job_id
     and json_value(q.payload,'$.rule')='education_conflict'
 ) then 1 else 0 end as bit) as education_conflict,
 cast(case when exists (
   select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."quality_issue" q
   where q.batch_id=j.batch_id
     and json_value(q.payload,'$.source_job_id') COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2=j.source_job_id

 ) then 1 else 0 end as bit) as location_conflict
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."trial_job_detail" j

select j.build_id,case when j.location_conflict=1 then N'冲突待确认'

 count_big(distinct j.observation_key) as posting_count
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_job_detail" j

select distinct j.build_id,j.batch_id,j.observation_key,j.version_key,s.skill_key,s.skill_name

select j.build_id,j.source,j.source_job_id,j.batch_id,j.version_key,j.is_core,
 s.skill_name,b.requirement_level,b.eligible_for_metric,b.evidence_count,b.evidence_json,
 j.dictionary_version,j.rule_version,j.scope_version,j.body_hash_version,j.skill_text_scope
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_job_detail" j
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_version_skill" b on b.build_id=j.build_id and b.version_key=j.version_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."skill" s on s.skill_key=b.skill_key

-- One release x date x conservative job identity; retain source identity and evidence.
select f.release_id,f.date_key,dt.calendar_date as analysis_date,dt.calendar_year,dt.calendar_quarter,dt.calendar_month,
 f.job_key,f.build_id,j.observation_key,j.version_key,j.source,j.source_job_id,j.batch_id,j.title_raw,j.source_url,
 co.company_name,cat.category_name as category_group,ed.education_name as education_group,
 ex.experience_name as experience_group,em.employment_type_name as employment_type_group,
 q.qualification_rule_version,
 json_value(q.education_resolution_json,'$.status') as education_resolution_status,
 json_value(q.education_resolution_json,'$.basis') as education_basis,
 case json_value(q.education_resolution_json,'$.status')
  when 'structured' then N'来源学历字段' when 'body_required' then N'正文明确要求'
  when 'preference_only' then N'仅有学历偏好' when 'not_stated' then N'未注明学历'
  when 'conflict' then N'来源与正文冲突' when 'ambiguous' then N'条件复杂待确认'
  when 'unparsed' then N'待解析' else N'历史版本' end as education_basis_label,
 q.education_resolution_json,q.experience_resolution_json,
 j.category_raw,j.education_raw,j.experience_raw,f.is_core,f.body_valid,
 j.location_conflict,j.education_conflict,j.experience_conflict,j.experience_hint,
 j.raw_ref,j.raw_sha256,j.content_json,j.additional_requirements_raw,j.issues_json,j.scope_reason,
 j.body_hash_version,j.dictionary_version,j.rule_version,j.scope_version,j.skill_text_scope,
 b.channel,b.normalization_version,b.mapping_version,
 c.coverage_status,c.acceptance_status,
 case when b.channel='sample' then N'来源岗位样本；覆盖不完整；不推导市场趋势' else N'批准范围内完整观察；不等于企业新增或关闭' end as dataset_note
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_job_detail" j on j.build_id=f.build_id and j.observation_key=f.observation_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."model_build" b on b.release_id=f.release_id and b.status='ready'
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."collection_batch" c on c.batch_id=j.batch_id
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."calendar_date" dt on dt.date_key=f.date_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."company" co on co.company_key=f.company_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."job_category" cat on cat.category_key=f.category_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."education" ed on ed.education_key=f.education_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."experience" ex on ex.experience_key=f.experience_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."employment_type" em on em.employment_type_key=f.employment_type_key
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."job_qualification_evidence" q
 on q.release_id=f.release_id and q.date_key=f.date_key and q.job_key=f.job_key
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=f.release_id)

select f.release_id,f.date_key,f.job_key,concat(f.release_id,'|',f.date_key,'|',f.job_key) as snapshot_key,
 case v.qualification_kind when 'education' then N'学历' else N'经验' end as qualification_kind,
 q.qualification_rule_version,json_value(v.resolution,'$.value') as qualification_value,
 json_value(v.resolution,'$.status') as resolution_status,e.evidence_field,e.evidence,e.evidence_start,e.evidence_end,
 e.strength,e.degree,j.source,j.source_job_id,j.raw_ref,j.raw_sha256,
 json_value(v.resolution,'$.record_ref') as record_ref,json_query(v.resolution,'$.raw_refs') as raw_refs_json
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."job_qualification_evidence" q on q.release_id=f.release_id and q.date_key=f.date_key and q.job_key=f.job_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_job_detail" j on j.build_id=f.build_id and j.observation_key=f.observation_key
cross apply (values ('education',q.education_resolution_json),('experience',q.experience_resolution_json)) v(qualification_kind,resolution)
cross apply openjson(v.resolution,'$.evidence') with (
 evidence_field nvarchar(100) '$.field',evidence nvarchar(max) '$.text',evidence_start int '$.start',evidence_end int '$.end',
 strength nvarchar(40),degree nvarchar(100)) e
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=f.release_id)

select j.batch_id,j.source,
 case when j.location_conflict=1 then N'冲突待确认'
      when l.location_raw in (N'北京市',N'北京') then N'北京'
      when l.location_raw in (N'上海市',N'上海') then N'上海'
      when l.location_raw in (N'广州市',N'广州') then N'广州'
      when l.location_raw in (N'杭州市',N'杭州') then N'杭州'
      when l.location_raw in (N'深圳市',N'深圳') then N'深圳'
      else coalesce(l.location_raw,N'未知') end as city_group,
 count_big(distinct j.observation_key) as source_posting_count,
 cast('pilot_city_alias_v1' as varchar(40)) as city_rule_version
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."dual_job_detail" j
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_version_location" b
 on b.version_key=j.version_key and b.normalization_version='raw_location_v1'
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."location" l on l.location_key=b.location_key
group by j.batch_id,j.source,
 case when j.location_conflict=1 then N'冲突待确认'
      when l.location_raw in (N'北京市',N'北京') then N'北京'
      when l.location_raw in (N'上海市',N'上海') then N'上海'
      when l.location_raw in (N'广州市',N'广州') then N'广州'
      when l.location_raw in (N'杭州市',N'杭州') then N'杭州'
      when l.location_raw in (N'深圳市',N'深圳') then N'深圳'
      else coalesce(l.location_raw,N'未知') end

select source,batch_id,
 case when education_conflict=1 then N'冲突待确认'
      else coalesce(education_raw,N'未知') end as education_group,
 count_big(*) as source_posting_count
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."dual_job_detail"
group by source,batch_id,
 case when education_conflict=1 then N'冲突待确认' else coalesce(education_raw,N'未知') end
select * from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."cd_scope_summary"

select s.build_id,s.skill_key,s.skill_name,count_big(*) as posting_count,
 m.skill_denominator,
 cast(count_big(*) as float)/nullif(m.skill_denominator,0) as skill_share,
 m.source,m.scope_version,m.rule_version,m.dictionary_version,m.body_hash_version,m.skill_text_scope
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."cd_eligible_job_skill" s
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."cd_scope_summary" m on m.build_id=s.build_id
group by s.build_id,s.skill_key,s.skill_name,m.skill_denominator,m.source,m.scope_version,m.rule_version,m.dictionary_version,m.body_hash_version,m.skill_text_scope

select a.build_id,a.skill_name as skill_a,b.skill_name as skill_b,
 count_big(*) as posting_count,m.skill_denominator,
 cast(count_big(*) as float)/nullif(m.skill_denominator,0) as pair_share,
 m.source,m.scope_version,m.rule_version,m.dictionary_version,m.body_hash_version,m.skill_text_scope
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."cd_eligible_job_skill" a
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."cd_eligible_job_skill" b
 on a.build_id=b.build_id and a.observation_key=b.observation_key and a.skill_key<b.skill_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."cd_scope_summary" m on m.build_id=a.build_id
group by a.build_id,a.skill_name,b.skill_name,m.skill_denominator,
 m.source,m.scope_version,m.rule_version,m.dictionary_version,m.body_hash_version,m.skill_text_scope

select b.*
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."cd_scope_summary" b
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."analysis_selection" s
 on s.batch_id=b.batch_id and s.build_id=b.build_id

select f.release_id,f.date_key,f.job_key,concat(f.release_id,'|',f.date_key,'|',f.job_key) as snapshot_key,
 e.skill_name,e.eligible_for_metric,x.*
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_skill_evidence" e on e.build_id=f.build_id and e.version_key=f.representative_version_key
cross apply openjson(e.evidence_json) with (
 evidence_field nvarchar(100),evidence nvarchar(max),raw_ref nvarchar(1000),
 evidence_start int,evidence_end int,body_hash_version nvarchar(100)
) x
where exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."publication_history" publication
        where publication.release_id=f.release_id)

select b.batch_id
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."trial_overview" b
join (select batch_id,sum(source_posting_count) as count_rows
      from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."dual_education" group by batch_id) e on e.batch_id=b.batch_id
where b.source_posting_count<>e.count_rows
union all
select c.batch_id
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."dual_city" c join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."trial_overview" b on b.batch_id=c.batch_id
where c.source_posting_count>b.source_posting_count

-- Grain: one immutable analysis build x one project operational KPI.
-- Goals are project acceptance conditions, never employer recruitment targets.
with traced_jobs as (
 select j.build_id,
  cast(case when nullif(j.source_url,N'') is not null
    and len(j.source_revision)=40
    and exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ods"."raw_response" r
                where r.batch_id=j.batch_id and r.relative_path=j.raw_ref
                  and r.sha256=j.raw_sha256)
    then 1 else 0 end as bigint) as is_traced
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_job_detail" j
), traceability as (
 select build_id,count_big(*) as posting_count,sum(is_traced) as traced_count
 from traced_jobs group by build_id
), metrics as (
 select s.build_id,s.batch_id,s.source,s.scope_version,s.body_hash_version,
  s.rule_version,s.dictionary_version,c.coverage_status,c.acceptance_status,
  k.kpi_code,k.kpi_name,k.owner_role,k.numerator,k.denominator
 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_overview" s
 join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."collection_batch" c on c.batch_id=s.batch_id
 join traceability t on t.build_id=s.build_id
 cross apply (values
  ('core_body_coverage',N'核心岗位正文覆盖率',N'数据加工与技能分析',s.skill_denominator,s.core_posting_count),
  ('raw_traceability',N'来源岗位原文可追溯率',N'四来源采集与入库',t.traced_count,t.posting_count),
  ('collection_scope_complete',N'批准采集范围遍历完成率',N'来源采集与验收',
   cast(case when c.coverage_status='complete' then 1 else 0 end as bigint),cast(1 as bigint))
 ) k(kpi_code,kpi_name,owner_role,numerator,denominator)
)
select *,
 cast(numerator as float)/nullif(denominator,0) as kpi_value,
 cast(1.0 as float) as goal_value,
 case when denominator=0 then cast(null as int)
      when numerator=denominator then 1 else -1 end as status_value,
 cast(null as int) as trend_value,
 cast('no_comparable_daily_series' as varchar(64)) as trend_reason,
 cast('project_acceptance_v1' as varchar(64)) as target_version
from metrics

-- One row per actual violation. Publication requires zero rows for the release.
select b.release_id,'empty_release' as issue_code
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."model_build" b
where b.status='ready' and not exists(select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f where f.release_id=b.release_id)
union all
select f.release_id,'observation_version_mismatch' as issue_code
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_posting_observation" o on o.observation_key=f.observation_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."job" j on j.job_key=f.job_key
where f.representative_version_key<>o.version_key or j.posting_key<>o.posting_key
union all
select f.release_id,'missing_city' from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
where not exists (select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_daily_city" c where c.release_id=f.release_id and c.date_key=f.date_key and c.job_key=f.job_key)
union all
select f.release_id,'daily_skill_ineligible' from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_daily_skill" s on s.release_id=f.release_id and s.date_key=f.date_key and s.job_key=f.job_key
where f.is_core=0 or f.body_valid=0 or not exists (
 select 1 from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."bridge_version_skill" b
 where b.build_id=f.build_id and b.version_key=f.representative_version_key and b.skill_key=s.skill_key and b.eligible_for_metric=1)
union all
select m.release_id,'count_or_denominator_error' from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_daily_summary" m
where m.skill_denominator>m.core_posting_count or m.core_posting_count>m.source_posting_count
union all
select s.release_id,'skill_count_exceeds_denominator' from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."release_skill_demand" s where s.posting_count>s.skill_denominator
union all
select m.release_id,'formal_incomplete_day' from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dws"."release_daily_summary" m
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."model_build" b on b.release_id=m.release_id
where b.channel='formal' and m.is_complete=0
union all
select i.release_id,'input_count_mismatch' from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."release_input" i
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_overview" c on c.build_id=i.build_id
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f on f.release_id=i.release_id and f.build_id=i.build_id
group by i.release_id,i.build_id,c.source_posting_count
having count_big(f.observation_key)<>c.source_posting_count
union all
select f.release_id,'qualification_resolution_mismatch'
from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."fact_job_daily" f
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."audit"."model_build" b on b.release_id=f.release_id
left join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dwd"."job_qualification_evidence" q
 on q.release_id=f.release_id and q.date_key=f.date_key and q.job_key=f.job_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."education" ed on ed.education_key=f.education_key
join "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."dim"."experience" ex on ex.experience_key=f.experience_key
where b.normalization_version='conformed-cn-1.1' and (
 q.job_key is null or json_value(q.education_resolution_json,'$.value')<>ed.education_name
 or json_value(q.experience_resolution_json,'$.value')<>ex.experience_name)

select build_id from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_skill_demand"
where posting_count>skill_denominator or skill_share<0 or skill_share>1
union all
select build_id from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_skill_pair"
where posting_count>skill_denominator or pair_share<0 or pair_share>1

with k as (select * from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_quality_kpi")
select build_id from k
where numerator<0 or denominator<0 or numerator>denominator
 or goal_value<>1.0
 or (denominator=0 and (kpi_value is not null or status_value is not null))
 or (denominator>0 and (kpi_value is null or abs(kpi_value-cast(numerator as float)/denominator)>0.000000001
   or status_value is null or status_value<>case when numerator=denominator then 1 else -1 end))
 or trend_value is not null or trend_reason<>'no_comparable_daily_series'
union all
select build_id from k group by build_id,kpi_code having count_big(*)<>1
union all
select s.build_id from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."cd_overview" s
left join k on k.build_id=s.build_id
group by s.build_id having count(k.kpi_code)<>3
union all
-- Partial/failed input must never get a green completeness signal.
select build_id from k where kpi_code='collection_scope_complete'
 and ((coverage_status<>'complete' and (numerator<>0 or status_value<>-1))
   or (coverage_status='complete' and (numerator<>1 or status_value<>1)))
select * from "recruitment_dw_dev_expansion_v1"."ads"."release_validation"
